description: Generated by `metabind pull`. Enum values reflect this project at pull time; re-pull after adding a component or secret.

allowedDomains.description: Hostnames this tool's handler may call. An empty list blocks all outbound requests.

annotations.description: Behaviour hints for MCP hosts. Only the four booleans below have any effect.

destructiveHint.description: The tool can destroy or overwrite data. Defaults to false.

idempotentHint.description: Calling the tool twice with the same input is the same as calling it once. Defaults to true.

openWorldHint.description: The tool reaches systems outside this project. Defaults to false.

readOnlyHint.description: The tool does not modify anything. Defaults to true.

title.description: Display name an MCP host shows for this tool. Defaults to the tool's name. Note this is `config.title`, not `config.annotations.title` — a title under `annotations` is ignored.

description.description: What this tool does. Shown to MCP hosts.

packageVersion.description: Published package to pin to, or "draft" to track the working state.

rootComponent.description: The component this tool renders. Must be a component in this project.

rootComponentId.description: Root component id, for a root that is not a component of this project. Prefer `rootComponent`.

title: Metabind tool
